title: Glossier You Solid Perfume
descriptionHtml:
✓ Layerable Scent✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy

Scent Type: Warm & Sheer

Key Notes: Pink Pepper, Iris, Ambrox

Fragrance Description: With an alcohol-free, anhydrous wax base that melts into skin and holds the fragrance close, Glossier You Solid smells soft, warm, and intimate—almost like it's part of you. Pink pepper is the bright, sparkling, spicy top note. Then comes a woodsy, slightly sweet heart of ambrette alongside creamy, musky, salty ambrox. The composition is balanced with iris root, a white floral, for powdery freshness.

About the Bottle: The ultimate personal fragrance, You Solid comes in the ultimate personal format: a refillable, pocket- and travel-friendly metal compact sculpted to perfectly fit the curve of y
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Swing open the compact and press your finger into the solid perfume

-Swipe onto your wrists, neck, and elsewhere.

-Repeat as desired

Ingredients+

Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Fragrance/Parfum, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Di-C12-15 Alkyl Fumarate, Synthetic Beeswax, Isoeicosane, Silica, Caprylyl Glycol, Hydroxycitronellal, Farnesol, Limonene.
